# GonkaStats by Nosyt Labs
Independent, read-only Gonka community observatory. Not an official Gonka service.

## Discovery
- /developers: interactive REST reference.
- /api/v1/openapi: implemented OpenAPI specification.
- /api/v1/overview: normalized snapshot and individual source metadata.
- /api/v1/metrics: values with units, definitions and scope.
- /api/v1/protocol: current model lifecycle, PoC parameters, DevShard approvals and software versions.
- /api/v1/providers: provider-layer roles and observed public-source state.
- /api/v1/source-health: freshness, coverage and dependent GonkaStats pages.
- /api/v1/sources: freshness and coverage.
- /api/v1/endpoints: imported upstream RPC catalog, documentation only.
- /methodology: metric definitions and limitations.

## Data rules
Raw ledger amounts are decimal strings. Missing data is null, never an invented zero. Source time and retrieval time differ. Issued supply is not circulating supply. Provider conversion references are not market trades. Declared epoch weights are not a current consensus-power distribution. No billable inference, signing, wallet private keys or arbitrary fetch tools are supported.

## Gonka sources
https://rpc.gonka.gg/agents
https://rpc.gonka.gg/llms.txt
https://rpc.gonka.gg/llms-full.txt
https://rpc.gonka.gg/api/endpoints
https://gonka.ai/docs/

Use /api/v1/openapi for the current implemented GonkaStats route set; do not rely on a hardcoded tool count. The upstream structured endpoint catalog is discovery metadata. A discovered write/broadcast/training endpoint is documentation only and is never authorization to execute it.

## HTTP behavior
Successful observations may contain partial source coverage; inspect meta.sources. Failed operations and unavailable health/status checks return a non-2xx status plus error, with detail/provenance when available. Detail and epoch-comparison failures include a machine-readable errorCode. Error responses are no-store. A 429 includes Retry-After. Conditional GET uses ETag/If-None-Match; 304 has no JSON body. Cross-origin preflight permits read-only methods and If-None-Match, never credentials or write operations.
